request.state: Can is an unimplemented business-language design with drafted typed outbox sends, associated delivery receipts, verified service events, transaction fencing and authorized page refresh. Actual new Chat and Creative sources duplicate three completion adapters plus one changed-event adapter, a local Observation event, and stored sequence/state snapshots. Their distinct work is reserving/settling token or job allowances and admitting immutable messages/images. A reusable provider adapter is already required to retain request digest and source/revision correlation, decode/coalesce streaming, enforce sequence and terminal evidence, preserve uncertainty, target cancellation safely and finalize application files. Prior consultations compared typed capability snapshots with a broad run language and lossless event log, favoring snapshots; they did not assess a typed progress view on the existing receipt. We now explicitly assess that alternative in response to the users desire for smaller primitives. Each option must preserve the same complete company workflow, authorization/revocation, branch and workflow version freezing, approved gallery sharing, token/job ceilings, stop versus confirmation, reconnect without another submission and transport versus business completion. Exact historical tokens are unnecessary. Necessary edge contracts are original-request admission for pre-ack snapshots, durable cancellation-before-start tombstones, unchanged identity/request replay, no redirection after a business association is replaced, immutable terminal output with nullable usage settling once, independently retried app callbacks and durable availability of final output/usage after restart. No approach may infer no remote effect from a failed receipt. None is implemented; all bear these provider/runtime proof obligations.

observed_progress.instructions: Select the most suitable bounded surface for finishing these drafts, considering source simplicity, reuse, clear domain ownership, honest recovery/privacy and specification scope with equal weight.

criteria.app_snapshots: Retain the existing ordinary capability API and app-maintained progress rows with four bridges into the domain handler. Protocol normalization stays in the adapter, source projections remain explicit, and no mutable receipt property is added. The cost is duplicated plumbing and potentially delayed UI progress when a domain callback fails.
criteria.associated_progress: Add a typed progress property and progressed notification to delivery associations only for operations whose standard manifest declares the observable-run relationship. The shared layer merges verified start/cancel/reconcile responses and event snapshots into the original receipt under field/file authorization and read fencing. App code reads that current progress and owns one idempotent handler for domain outcomes/accounting. It removes the repeated mirrors/bridges and exposes accepted evidence despite domain errors, while requiring new manifest routing, provenance, notification recovery and test-recipe contracts.
criteria.run_construct: Add a standalone run value with dedicated start/observe/cancel/reconcile forms and common generated controls. Keep provider normalization in adapters and business effects in source. This names the concept directly and may generalize well, but creates more new syntax/types/effects and authority/replay/lowering decisions than the narrower receipt extension.
